stopCaptureCriteriaType.description: The stop capture capture criteria type

stopCaptureCriteria.description: Define how the capture will stop

expectedNbOfPax.description: Number of passenger expected to be captured

detectionTimeout.description: timeout to detect a person (in seconds)

logRecordsMaxSize.description: Log records max size in the device

volumeConfiguration.description: Capture volume frame transform from the volume to the product. Warning: if sets, it requires a reboot of the device

lightsOn.description: Enable or disable capture LEDs lighting

qualityEvaluationStrategy.description: fixed: 'Wait all expected biometrics (according to Modality) to be R4V intelligent: 'According to the CaptureMode value and the context, the system will automatically adjust the overall target quality

captureScenario.description: Defines the scenario in which the capture takes place

retentionPeriod.description: Duration in seconds that capture result are retained for

maxCaptureRetained.description: Maximum number of capture result retained by the device

capturePersonTimeout.description: The timeout to try to capture a person for multiple capture (in seconds)

compressionLevel.description: Compression level from 0 (faster, no compression) to 9 (slower, max compression).

qualityLevel.description: Quality level use for JPEG compression. The lower the quality, the smaller is the file. Quality less than 95 should not be use for biometric recognition .

maxOutputSize.description: Maximum size (in byte) of the file after JPEG2000 compression.  If this value is bigger that what can be achieved, the compression will be lossless. Use lossless compression for Iris recognition (307200 for irises).

imageHeightConfiguration.description: Height configuration used for the image

imageWidthConfiguration.description: Width configuration used for the image

faceImageConfiguration.description: Face image output configuration. Pay attention to the recommendation for biometric recognition in case of lossy format.

irisImageConfiguration.description: Irises image output configuration. Pay attention to the recommendation for biometric recognition in case of lossy format.

secure.description: true for secure webservice, false for unsecure webservice.

personFaceBox.description: Rectangle around person face in image. Location is a corner of the rectangle

liveImagePersonMetadata.description: Metadata of a person in live image

persons.description: Metadata of persons seen in image. Currently, only one person can be seen in live image.

nextFirmwareChunkInfos.description: Information of next firmware chunk expected

nextOffset.description: Next firmware chunk offset in bytes

firmwareToken.description: Use this token for firmware upgrade

nextOffset.description: Offset in bytes required for first chunk transfered

nextChunkSize.description: Next chunk size expected in bytes

referenceId.description: The link to the best reference found

data.description: Firmware chunk binary data encoded in base64

offset.description: Chunk offset in binary file before base64 encoding

pkcs12.description: PKCS#12 that contains certificate and private key protected by password.

liveness.description: Tells whether the captured biometric data is considered or not as a liveness data

ipv4SubnetMask.description: Sub network mask for IPv4 addresses

ipv4Gateway.description: IPv4 address of the network gateway

timeFromDetection.description: Duration elapsed from the first detection to the end of the capture of a person. Units: seconds

left.description: x,y coordinates of the left eye position

right.description: x,y coordinates of the right eye position

status.description: The user face biometry status when the data has been returned

image.description: Image for display cropped from the context image on the captured face. See the BestShot section for more information about visual quality

bioTemplate.description: Biometric template resulting from the face capture

pixelCoordinates.description: coordinates (x, y) of a pixel in image. Unit: pixel

imageRegionSize.description: Size of an image region of interest in pixels
